beats.summary: Michael expresses insecurity about being liked and reacts angrily to Toby's counseling attempts.

evidence.snippet: Michael: I was afraid I would find him in the park, playing with another kid.
Michael: You. Bitch. God! You're very helpful aren't you? You try to help everybody.

beats.summary: Michael fills out and signs counseling forms reluctantly and with frustration.

evidence.snippet: Toby (tossing forms at Michael): Just fill them out any way you want.
Michael grabs form and signs it without reading.

beats.summary: Gabe questions Toby's evaluation of Michael, noting severe ratings including risk of homicidal behavior.

evidence.snippet: Gabe: You marked severe in all the categories, including at risk for homicidal behavior.

beats.summary: Gabe confronts Pam about her unofficial status as office administrator due to lack of paperwork.

evidence.snippet: Pam: So weird that there is no paperwork.

beats.summary: Dwight seeks revenge at a store where he was previously refused service, ultimately purchasing a wizard figurine.

evidence.snippet: Dwight: I was here yesterday, and you refused to wait on me.
Dwight (re-entEring the store): I'll take the wizard!

beats.summary: Michael accuses Toby of forging forms, but Toby points out Michael filled and faxed them himself.

evidence.snippet: Michael: You forged them! You forged the forms!
Toby: You filled them in and faxed them yourself!
